evidence.quote: although the pace of employment growth has picked up in recent months and the unemployment rate has fallen some, the labor market remains quite weak.
These circumstances have called for forceful policy measures.
In my judgment, our deployment of unconventional policy tools has been completely appropriate to help promote the Federal Reserve's statutory mandate of maximum employment and price stability.

However, certain factors could be constraining the channels through which monetary policy accommodation affects the economy. In particular, many small businesses appear to be facing unusual obstacles in obtaining credit.

parsed.rationale: The speech is partly about monetary policy, stressing a very weak labor market, defending forceful accommodation including balance sheet operations, and flagging impaired transmission of policy through constrained small-business credit. It gives no explicit forward signal and says nothing about inflation, and much of the text concerns bank supervision, so the stance is a moderate dovish lean.
